## 4. Base rates
- In September 2026, through 9/21, BTC traded in roughly a $74.9k to $86k range, about a 15% swing. It went from about $75.9k on 9/16 to about $85.8k on 9/21, a rise of about 13% in 5 days.
- 2026-08-12: BTC was around $63,500 [Bitcoin.com](https://news.bitcoin.com/year-end-bitcoin-price-predictions-grow-cautious-as-bettors-eye-81k/), so the price has climbed about 35% in about 6 weeks.
- A rough reference: with about 50-60% annualized volatility, a 9-day 1-sigma move is about 8-9%. That makes a drop of 12.6% or more (about 1.4-1.5 sigma) at any point in the window historically uncommon, though it does happen during sharp risk-off episodes. This is my own estimate; I didn't find a published base rate for it.
